caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing female figure set against an off-white or light beige background. The figure is dressed in layered garments that include a long skirt, a belted waist, and a peplum-like overlayer with a fitted bodice featuring intricate folds and pleats. The coloration of the garments incorporates muted earth tones, primarily brownish-gray, with hints of green and yellowish-brown on the lower sections of the skirt. The statue’s posture shows the left arm bent upward toward the chest and the right arm lowered outward, while her head is turned slightly to her left. The details of the face, hair, and clothing are rendered with shading that gives the statue a dimensional and lifelike stone or painted wood texture. The figure stands atop a rounded, irregularly shaped base that suggests it is a statue, and there are no other objects in the composition.
title: Female Figurehead
